data.name: Emaanul
data.gender_notes: Emaanul is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'iman' meaning faith or belief. In Islamic theology, emaan (faith) is a vital component of a Muslim's spiritual life, and is considered the foundation of a strong relationship with Allah. The name Emaanul carries the meaning “Faith, Belief” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Emaanul usually hope their child will grow to embody faith, belief and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering commitment to Allah and His teachings.
data.etymology: Emaanul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Faith, Belief.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emaanul total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إيمانول
in_arabic.meaning: الإيمان بالله ورسوله وحدوثه من إحدى المظاهر العالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإيمان بالله هو العقل السليم وروح الحق، ورسوله هو سيدنا محمد عليه الصلاة والسلام، والإيمان بهما يعد أحد المظاهر العالية في الإسلام، ويُشير إلى إيمان الفرد بأنه مخلوق الله، ورسوله، ويُعتبر هذا الإيمان من أهم أركان الإسلام، ويُعد إيمان الأمة المسلمة بأنها أمة إسلامية، ويُشير إلى الحق والصدق، والوحدانية، وهو مُصطلح يستخدم في القرآن الكريم للإشارة إلى الإيمان بالله ورسوله.
